sents.t: Movietown News presents: Spotlight on Adventure.
sents.zh: 《电影城新闻》为您呈现：冒险聚光灯。

sents.t: What you are now witnessing is footage never before seen by civilized humanity,
sents.zh: 您现在看到的，是文明人类从未见过的影像，

sents.t: Lurking in the shadow of majestic Paradise Falls, it sports plants and animals undiscovered by science.
sents.zh: 它隐藏在雄伟的天堂瀑布的阴影里，拥有科学尚未发现的植物和动物。

sents.t: Who would dare set foot on this inhospitable summit?
sents.zh: 谁敢踏上这座荒凉险恶的山顶？

sents.t: The beloved explorer lands his dirigible, the Spirit of Adventure,
sents.zh: 这位深受爱戴的探险家驾着他的飞艇“冒险精神号”降落，

sents.t: completing a year-long expedition to the lost world.
sents.zh: 完成了前往失落世界、为期一年的探险。

sents.t: and is longer than 22 Prohibition paddy wagons placed end to end.
sents.zh: 比 22 辆禁酒令时期的警车首尾相连还要长。

sents.t: Never apart from his faithful dogs,
sents.zh: 他从不离开他忠诚的狗狗们，

sents.t: Muntz conceived the craft for canine comfort.
sents.zh: 蒙兹设计这艘飞艇时，就考虑到了狗狗的舒适。

sents.t: It's a veritable floating palace in the sky,
sents.zh: 它简直就是一座空中漂浮的宫殿，

sents.t: complete with doggy bath and mechanical canine walker.
sents.zh: 还配有狗狗浴池和机械遛狗机。

sents.t: And, Jiminy Cricket, do the locals consider Muntz the bee's knees!
sents.zh: 天哪，当地人可真觉得蒙兹棒极了！

sents.t: And, golly, what a swell monster this is!
sents.zh: 哎呀，这怪物可真了不起！

sents.t: But what's this? Scientists cry foul.
sents.zh: 可这是怎么回事？科学家们大喊不公。

sents.t: The National Explorers Society accuses Muntz of fabricating the skeleton.
sents.zh: 国家探险家协会指控蒙兹伪造了这副骨架。

sents.t: The organization strips Muntz of his membership.
sents.zh: 该组织取消了蒙兹的会员资格。

sents.t: Humiliated, Muntz vows a return to Paradise Falls and promises to capture the beast alive!
sents.zh: 蒙兹受了羞辱，发誓要重返天堂瀑布，并承诺要活捉那头怪兽！

sents.t: Here's Charles Muntz piloting his famous dirigible.
sents.zh: 这是查尔斯·蒙兹在驾驶他那艘著名的飞艇。

sents.t: He hurdles Pikes Peak.
sents.zh: 他飞越了派克斯峰。

sents.t: Mount Rushmore! Hard to starboard!
sents.zh: 拉什莫尔山！右满舵！

sents.t: Rudders 18 degrees towards the south.
sents.zh: 方向舵向南转 18 度。

sents.t: It's a beautiful day. Winds out of the east at 10 knots.
sents.zh: 天气真好。东风，风速 10 节。

sents.t: Visibility unlimited. Enter the weather in the logbook.
sents.zh: 能见度无限。把天气记进航海日志。

sents.t: Aw! It's a puppy! Ah! No time! A storm! Lightning. Hail.
sents.zh: 哇！是只小狗！啊！没时间了！暴风雨！闪电。冰雹。

sents.t: Don't you know this is an exclusive club?
sents.zh: 你不知道这是个专属俱乐部吗？

sents.t: Only explorers get in here, not just any kid off the street with a helmet and a pair of goggles.
sents.zh: 只有探险家才能进来，不是随便哪个戴着头盔和护目镜的街头小孩都行。

sents.t: All right, you're in. Welcome aboard.
sents.zh: 好吧，你入会了。欢迎加入。

sents.t: Thought you might need a little cheering up.
sents.zh: 我想你可能需要一点安慰，让你开心点。

sents.t: You'll have to swear you will not tell anyone.
sents.zh: 你得发誓不告诉任何人。

sents.t: Cross your heart. Do it!
sents.zh: 在胸口画十字发誓。快！

sents.t: I ripped this right out of a library book.
sents.zh: 这是我从图书馆的书上直接撕下来的。

sents.t: I'm gonna move my clubhouse there and park it right next to the falls.
sents.zh: 我要把我的俱乐部小屋搬到那儿，就放在瀑布旁边。

sents.t: That's it! You can take us there in a blimp!
sents.zh: 有了！你可以开飞艇带我们去！

sents.t: Cross it! Cross your heart! Good, you promised. No backing out.
sents.zh: 画呀！画十字发誓！好，你答应了。不许反悔。
